findings.title: Mine lease area stated as two different values

quotes.text: The total mine lease area is 142.6 ha, of which 98.4 ha is forest land.
The proposed lease covering an area of 162.6 ha falls in Survey of India toposheet 63D/10.

findings.evidence: Both statements describe the same mine lease boundary but differ by 20.0 ha. No expansion or phasing is mentioned between pages 12 and 47.
findings.message: Inconsistency flagged: the lease area differs between page 12 and page 47. Please verify which value is correct.

findings.title: Distance to Tons River differs

quotes.text: The nearest water body, Tons River, is located at a distance of 2.8 km (N) from the lease boundary.
Tons River flows at about 650 m north of the mine lease.

findings.evidence: Same river, same direction, distances of 2.8 km and 0.65 km. The page 63 figure may be measured from a different reference point, which the report does not state.
findings.message: Inconsistency flagged: two different distances to Tons River are given. Please verify the measurement reference.

findings.title: Water requirement vs production capacity

quotes.text: Total water requirement for the project is 45 KLD, sourced from groundwater.

findings.evidence: No breakdown of water use (dust suppression, plantation, domestic) is given, so the figure cannot be checked against production.
